name: pv4_redraw

name: e_line_redraw
prompt:
VFX ONLY. No character, no portrait, no scenery. Reference when attached is ONLY her physical blade shape/color, never draw the woman. Pixel art game VFX sprite sheet for a small tactics game: chunky square pixels, hard edges, no anti-aliasing, NO outline around light, slashes, trails or rings (only her solid blades get the dark #0A081C outline), BRIGHT colours (each light shape lit with its lightest shades and a white core - it must read on a dark battlefield), colours only from a crimson ramp (#FFFFFF, #FFC8D8, #F32D5B, #D51046, #A80A36, #750629), a cyan ramp (#FFFFFF, #D8FBFF, #84EBFF, #27CFF3, #098FBA), a silver ramp (#FFFFFF, #E8F4FC, #BDCFDF, #96ACC3, #6C7A98) and a navy ramp for the blades' backs (#4D6085, #344367, #222B51, #131A37, #0A081C).
Effect: a LINE BETWEEN TWO BLADES pointing RIGHT, 6 frames, SYMMETRIC TOP TO BOTTOM in every frame (the game turns it to its direction; going left it is flipped upside down): the picture spans the whole line, its LEFT edge is where she stands and its RIGHT edge 80 squares away. HER BLADE: a slim crescent blade like a curved leaf, crimson edge, navy back, a silver tip and a small cyan gem at its base, a 1-square dark outline - exactly the blades floating round her in design/irelia_design.png, lying flat along the line, 9 squares long. 1 a blade at each end; 2-4 the two blades flying toward the middle, each trailing a thin cyan beam (2 squares thick, white core) back to its end; 5 the blades meet in the middle in a white-cyan flash 10 squares tall; 6 the whole line glowing cyan-white 3 squares thick, the blades gone.

WORKING CONTACT SHEET (final horizontal strip will be exported separately): 6 frames, 1 columns x 6 rows, read LEFT TO RIGHT then TOP TO BOTTOM. Canvas 1312x1344, every working cell 1312x224; identical clear cell boundaries but do NOT draw boundaries. Each cell represents exactly 82x14 GAME PIXELS; draw the shapes in big pure-color square pixel blocks on that logical grid, not fine illustration. The effect sizes/positions in the Effect description are GAME PIXELS. Preserve animation progression distinct frames. Flat solid bright color clusters, pure white cores, no dark outlines on lights, no fuzzy halo, no anti-alias, no gradients, no dithering. Transparent empty spaces. No text, labels, numbers, borders or guides. No hero anywhere.
TIMING CORRECTION IS MANDATORY: frame1 two blades atleft/rightends; frame2 bladecenters20/60 gamepixels; frame3 centers30/50; frame4 centers36/44 still SEPARATED, NO CENTRAL FLASH, no starburst inframe4; frame5 centerWHITE-CYANflash atx41 ONLYnow theymeet; frame6 straightcyanline bladesgone. Six horizontal bands stacked vertically, no extra effects betweenbands. Blades alwaysmove inward, lefthandbladepointsRIGHT andrighthandbladepointsLEFT.
